sites.name: Lantern Freshwater Cove
sites.clue: Gulls wheel over still green water east of Lantern Cay.
sites.discovery: A spring-fed cove where a fleet can water and rest.
sites.hazard: Unmarked reef teeth on the southern approach.

sites.name: Kelpback Shoal Cut
sites.clue: A pale lane crosses the kelp beds north-east of Kelp Reach.
sites.discovery: A shallow-draft shortcut through Kelpback Shoal.
sites.hazard: Shifting sand bars ground deep hulls at low water.

sites.name: Kelpback Toll Camp
sites.clue: Cook-fire smoke rises where no village is charted.
sites.discovery: A defended toll camp watching the western sound.
sites.hazard: Armed camp; approach only with a plan.

sites.name: Sawtooth Ironwood Stand
sites.clue: Dark old-growth crowns show below the southern cliffs.
sites.discovery: An unworked ironwood stand above a landing beach.
sites.hazard: Steep landing; swell breaks on the shingle.

sites.name: Verdigris Salt Pans
sites.clue: White crust glitters on flats west of Verdigris Atoll.
sites.discovery: Evaporation pans over a saltpeter-bearing seam.
sites.hazard: Mudflats strand boats that miss the tide.

sites.name: Middle Marsh Landing
sites.clue: Cut reed bundles dry on poles along an empty channel.
sites.discovery: A firm marsh landing between Silt Hollow and the Floats.

sites.name: Cinder Crown Ore Seam
sites.clue: Rust-red scree fans reach the water south of Cinder Crown.
sites.discovery: A surface iron-ore seam workable from the beach.
sites.hazard: Loose volcanic scree and hot ground.

sites.name: Cinder Crown Workshop Ruin
sites.clue: A broken gantry silhouette stands south-east of Anvil Dock.
sites.discovery: An abandoned machine workshop with a sound forge bed.
sites.hazard: Collapsed roof timbers; shore parties must take care.

sites.name: Kettle Fen Sheltered Inlet
sites.clue: Calm water shows behind the fen headland in a blow.
sites.discovery: A sheltered inlet usable as a storm anchorage.
sites.hazard: Soft mud; anchors drag without a second hook.

sites.name: Oilstone Seep Terrace
sites.clue: A rainbow sheen spreads from terraces below the bluff.
sites.discovery: Natural oil seeps collectable into raw drums.
sites.hazard: Slick rock and fumes near the seep vents.

sites.name: Naphtha Sulfur Vents
sites.clue: Yellow staining marks the shore east of Naphtha Bay.
sites.discovery: Sulfur crusts around warm shore vents.
sites.hazard: Choking vent gas on still days.

sites.name: Middle Sea Chart Rock
sites.clue: A cairn and bottle-post stand on a lone sea rock.
sites.discovery: A weathered chart fragment naming an eastern wreck field.
sites.hazard: Exposed rock; no shelter in heavy weather.

sites.name: Rust Salvage Anchorage
sites.clue: Masts at odd angles crowd a quiet bay west of the Bastion.
sites.discovery: A salvage anchorage of beached prize hulls.
sites.hazard: Raider lookouts watch the bay from the headland.

sites.name: Shatter Wreck Field
sites.clue: Breakers foam over shapes that are not all rock.
sites.discovery: A charted wreck field with recovery opportunities.

sites.name: Westglass Bearing Stones
sites.clue: Pale stones stand above a narrow landing.
sites.discovery: The stones give an eastward bearing toward a raised signal ridge.
sites.hazard: Swell and loose timbers make the landing slow.

sites.name: Windglass Keeper's Log
sites.clue: A broken signal frame stands on the ridge.
sites.discovery: A keeper's log gives a south-west bearing toward a split stern.
sites.hazard: Swell and loose timbers make the landing slow.

sites.name: Longglass Supply Wreck
sites.clue: Split timbers interrupt the pale surf.
sites.discovery: A collapsed supply coaster holds finite surviving stores. Recovery needs a separate working party and hold space.
sites.hazard: Swell and loose timbers make the landing slow.
